title: Supply Chain Portfolio
short_summary: Curated supply chain + logistics analytics portfolio with dashboards, case studies, and code
summary: A curated portfolio of supply chain and logistics analytics work, combining dashboards, case studies, and reproducible code to analyze operational performance, cost drivers, service levels, and process improvement opportunities. Designed to showcase end-to-end analytics: data cleaning, KPI definitions, analysis, and stakeholder-ready deliverables.

datasets.dataset_value: Curated datasets referenced across portfolio projects (see repo folders/README for links)

components.name: Portfolio Overview (README / Navigation)
components.objective: Provide a clear entry point and navigation across supply chain analytics artifacts.
components.business_value: Reduces time-to-understand for recruiters/clients and makes the portfolio easy to scan, increasing the likelihood that key work is discovered quickly.

components.name: Dashboards & Visual Stories
components.objective: Present interactive and visual analysis of supply chain performance and cost drivers through dashboards and guided views.
components.business_value: Enables fast exploration of KPIs and root-cause patterns for decision support, reducing time to insight and improving stakeholder alignment.
files: Dashboard exports (PNG/PDF) and/or links referenced in README

components.name: Case Studies / Write-ups
components.objective: Communicate findings, assumptions, and recommendations in a stakeholder-friendly format with clear reasoning and takeaways.
components.business_value: Turns analysis into decisions by documenting insights and actions, making work reviewable, reusable, and easy to present in interviews or stakeholder readouts.
files: Case study write-ups (MD/PDF) referenced in README

components.name: Data Pipelines & Analysis Code
components.objective: Provide reproducible scripts for cleaning, transforming, and analyzing supply chain data, with reusable KPI logic and consistent data handling.
components.business_value: Improves repeatability and auditability, reduces rework, and enables quick iteration on KPI definitions and analysis without rebuilding from scratch.
